verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is the product's core interaction model. Users type or speak requests to edit files, images, and slides (docs-7, docs-46, docs-31, docs-5). They can delegate to subagents (docs-103) and drive larger Work tasks (docs-28). Voice lets them start work, check progress, or change direction without typing (docs-51, docs-76, docs-13, docs-105). Community hands-on reports corroborate driving complex behaviour through plain-language prompts (comm-1, comm-2). Missing for 10: recent independent hands-on corroboration of the agentic Work/voice controls, and evidence that settings and configuration can be changed by natural language rather than slash commands or config files.
